notes.title: Summer Update
notes.notes:
New Class 

Beach Boy:


The Beach Boy class introduces a new way to control the battlefield with summer-themed abilities and a water gun as its weapon. Beach Boy can set up sprinklers that spray water in all directions, damaging nearby enemies, and use a surfboard to block incoming attacks before sending it forward to strike opponents. Its ultimate ability covers the map with waves of sprinklers and surfboards, damaging all enemies caught in their path.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/0a33b49e42bf72adfd1be7769f65e15dd00d591f.png"]
New Items


This update also introduces several summer-themed items:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/d16875de5bb21faa7b92aad59dc412c6b1ec6077.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/36f553d146999452eea73aab42a1c4a1391abad5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/4f480c9cd99332970f1a2a8f6a97b660b9892748.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/a334be8f5c47e28747dd19b1de3a2606fe7d5ee9.png"]


Volleyball Net (Legendary Active)


Set up a volleyball net across the center of the map, damaging every enemy that collides with it. (30s cooldown)


Volleyball (Epic Active)


A volleyball orbits around the player, striking and damaging any enemies it touches. (30s cooldown)


Sun (Rare Passive)


The sun sharpens your focus, granting 5% precision, while its warmth fills you with 5% speed.


Sun Cream (Uncommon Consumable)


Apply sun cream to gain 1 vulnerability point and boost your speed by 10% for 5 seconds.

New Map


A new Summer Map is now available, offering a fresh environment to try out the new class and items.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/13da65cdfc29dd9a9db3b69fa69a3f6c42b3facf.png"]


Final Notes


For this update, the game will be on sale at 85% off,  so if you're interested, give it a try! In addition to that, the Beach Boy class and the two actives will be playable in the demo. As always, feel free to reach out on the Steam Discussion Board or Discord with any questions, suggestions, or bug reports. I hope this update adds some summer feeling to the game.

notes.title: Elements Update
notes.notes:
New Class

 Frostburn:

 The Forstburn class specializes in using elemental powers. Forstburn can switch between two orbs orbiting the player: an ice orb and a fire orb. Switching orbs grants a temporary 5-second buff and leaves behind either a fire node that deals damage or an ice pool that slows enemies. The ultimate ability transforms the entire map into either fire or ice, depending on which orb is currently equipped.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/14510c4013187251d04420d7adde95278cf5e4e0.png


New Items
This update includes 7 new elements which will act as a passive: 


  Legendary Items:

[olist]
 Air - Each time you gain speed, permanently increase your speed by 2%.
 Death - Gain 1 permanent damage for every 1000 points earned, up to a maximum of 3.
 Earth - Each time you prevent damage, permanently gain 0.2% luck.
 Light - Each time you land a precision hit, permanently gain 0.2% precision.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/df75bbbf290be38be4864dc962dbbcf08c0b0ed5.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/3bc657da1af7c69f934cc3c567be93e184ea4b4c.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/668da1f1a0ec70c63e1ec205a0a595df9ed31447.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/825bda2db44d257bbe7b96efa9ec37311aaf8136.png 
  Epic Items:

[olist]
 Fire - 5% chance to create a fire node when killing an enemy.
 Water - 5% chance to create a water pool when killing an enemy.
 Lightning - Strikes a random enemy every 10 seconds.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/b39d0ba09f620da62b62fd8c9ae180f9e9bc22c1.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/e10b30597de83739fb000006a428f26ac607069c.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/dfd13d59f4cba6e73ff511a544bec11e21e710c0.png 


Final Notes

For this update, the game will be on sale at 60% off, starting at 19 CET ( 10 PST) so if you're interested, give it a try! As always, feel free to reach out on the Steam Discussion Board or Discord with any questions, suggestions, or bug reports. I hope this update adds an exciting new passive ability that's fun to play with!

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year

Classes and Items

 2 new classes (Santa and Elf)
 2 new legendary items (snow storm and hot choco)
 2 new epic items (reindeer pack and mistletoe)
 2 new rare items (skates and candle)


Map

 Added a candy map skin (can be changed in video settings)


Bugs and Balancing

 Fixed an issue where options could not be closed by pressing escape in endless mode
